description: How many days until Christmas — counted in sleeps, not hours, and right across time zones. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

day.description: The day of the month. Defaults to the 25th. A day the month never has (30 February) is refused; 29 February counts to the next leap year. Whole calendar days are counted, the day itself is 0, and a date already passed rolls to next year.

month.description: The month of the occasion, 1 to 12. Defaults to December. Pass month and day together to count to any yearly date, such as a birthday.

today.description: The date to count from, as YYYY-MM-DD in the caller's own calendar. Defaults to today in UTC. The response repeats the date it counted from as countedFrom.

name: days_until_christmas
title: Days Until Christmas
